explanation: First locate the node by its Data value. Its successor is the leftmost node in its right subtree, if that subtree exists; otherwise climb Parent links until leaving a left child. No such ancestor means no successor.
timeComplexity: O(n) time to locate the node, then O(h) to find its successor.
spaceComplexity: O(h) auxiliary search stack for tree height h.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
